exactBindings.procedure: Use a frozen expected-contract table checked into the matrix, not the implementation under test. Scope AC2 to operations actually referenced by the nine current page routes (profile, saved/leads, resume, jobs/search, preparation and settings), plus the shared GET /api/session owner/auth boundary; authentication start/callback/logout, scheduled discovery, market/pipeline, admin and other provider/control-plane routes are explicitly out of this visual-acceptance criterion and remain owned by their dedicated tickets. GET /api/session must return HTTP 200 with `{authenticated:false,registrationEnabled:boolean,cognitoEnabled:boolean}` anonymously, or HTTP 200 with `{authenticated:true,csrf,email,phone,owner,aiEnabled}` for a valid local session; owner is exactly a 64-character SHA-256 digest and raw session tokens, provider tokens and raw owner IDs must never appear. GET /api/profile returns HTTP 200 with the owner profile or the documented revision-zero empty record, HTTP 401 when unauthenticated and HTTP 429 after the owner-keyed read budget; PUT /api/profile returns HTTP 200 on a valid owner save, 400 for malformed input, 401 unauthenticated, 403 Origin/CSRF failure, 409 for a stale revision with no row/event change, and 429 after the owner-keyed update budget. GET /api/leads returns HTTP 200 owner rows, 401 unauthenticated and 429 after the owner-keyed read budget; GET /api/leads/:id and /history return HTTP 200 for an owned record, safe HTTP 404 for missing or foreign records, 400 for malformed IDs, 401 unauthenticated and 429 for the read budget; GET /api/leads/by-job/:jobId returns HTTP 200 with `{lead:null}` for an unknown job, HTTP 400 for a malformed UUID, HTTP 401 unauthenticated and HTTP 429 for the read budget, and never returns another owner's lead. POST /api/leads returns HTTP 200 for a valid owner save, 400 for malformed input, 401 unauthenticated, 403 Origin/CSRF failure, 404 when the completed job is absent, and 429 after the owner-keyed update budget; PUT /api/leads/:id returns HTTP 200 for a valid update, 400 malformed input, 401 unauthenticated, 403 Origin/CSRF failure, 404 for missing or foreign leads, 409 for a stale revision where supported, and 429 after the owner-keyed update budget. The frozen table also lists: POST /api/searches (202 success; 400 malformed; 401 unauthenticated; 403 CSRF; 409 idempotency conflict; 429 rate limit; duplicate idempotency key returns the original result), GET /api/searches (200 or 401/429), GET /api/searches/:id (200; 400 malformed ID; 401 unauthenticated; 404 foreign/missing; 429), POST /api/searches/:id/cancel (200; 400/401/403/404/429; no cross-owner effect), GET export (200; 400/401/404/409/429), GET events (SSE 200; 400/401/404/429; owner-scoped replay); GET /api/resumes (200 or 401; no route-specific 429), POST resume (202; 400/401/403/409/413/429/503/507 with no partial publication), GET resume/:id (200; 400/401/404/503), recover/cancel (200; 400/401/403/404/409/429/503/507), DELETE resume (204; 400/401/403/409/429/503); GET /api/preparation (200/401/429), POST preparation/:checkId/ai-elaborate (200; 400/401/403/404/429/502/503/504 and no resume/contact/compensation data); POST /api/account/sessions/revoke-others and POST /api/account/password each return 204 on success, 400 for validation, 401 for unauthenticated, 403 for Origin/CSRF failure and 429 when rate-limited; revoke-others invalidates every other session while preserving the current session, and password change clears the current session after the credential update. Unsupported/disabled routes assert their documented 404/405/503 and no side effect. For NOT_APPLICABLE design-only rows assert no invented API call or success state.
